remarks: Be the first one to call this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment on the 2nd floor yours. The apartment is a perfect blend of modern style and convenience. Step inside to find brand-new flooring, updated lighting, an updated bath, and a sleek kitchen featuring new cabinets, granite countertops and new stainless-steel appliances. The unit also includes the convenience of in-unit laundry, air conditioning and a charming, covered porch, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. Located in a vibrant area, you'll have easy access to local restaurants, shops, parks, and quick connections to I-95 and Route 1. With off street parking, and additional storage provided in your own space located within the garage, this apartment truly has it all-comfort, style and accessibility! Schedule today.
